limits: Independently bootable one-shot resident disks. Manual disk swaps pause sound; the full 300-s WAV is continuous. No complete film rebuild or physical-hardware claim.

simulation_feedback.objective: mean absolute masked log-spectral MAE for 512/2048/8192 + 0.35 * 20-ms RMS log-MAE; fixed calibration

psychoacoustic.limitations: Tunable approximation of critical bands, simultaneous and short forward masking; no standard compliance or listening-quality guarantee.

simulation_feedback.limitations: Bounded local proposals, not a global optimum; three channels cannot reproduce arbitrary PCM. Playback SPL and analogue circuit response are unknown.

necessary_noise.necessity: 3-field mean of complete tone-only minus noise-enabled perceptual error
necessary_noise.limitations: Conservative audibility policy requested after listening; ordinary spectral error can increase when weak residual noise is omitted. Not perfect source separation.

hardware_envelope.limitations: One shared nonlinear 16-level AY DAC envelope (paired 32-counter steps in Ayumi), bounded proposals and coarse frequency grid; not an ideal triangle or arbitrary independent channel envelopes.
